API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIData Loss PreventionC2C Incident Receiver Resource Get C2cir Lite
C2C Incident Receiver Resource Get C2cir Lite
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudToCloudIR/lite

Retrieves the list of DLP Incident Receivers configured for Cloud-to-Cloud DLP Incident Forwarding, with a subset of information for each Incident Receiver. For complete details of each Incident Receiver including the configuration information, use the GET /cloudToCloudIR request.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size

Default value: 50
search
string

The search string used to match against the names of Cloud-to-Cloud Incident Forwarding tenants and their configurations

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

System-generated unique ID of the Cloud-to-Cloud DLP Incident Forwarding tenant

name
string

User-provided name for the SaaS application tenant

Possible values: <= 128 characters, Value must match regular expression ^[a-zA-Z_0-9-\._]+[a-zA-Z_0-9-\._\s]*$

status
string[]

The status of the tenant

Possible values: [CASB_TENANT_ACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_INACTIVE, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATING, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_SUCCESS, CASB_TENANT_VALIDATION_FAIL, CASB_TENANT_NORMAL_RETHORIZATION, CASB_TENANT_CONNECTOR_RETHORIZATION]

modifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the tenant was last modified

lastModifiedBy
object
lastTenantValidationTime
int32

Timestamp when the tenant was last validated

lastValidationMsg
object
onboardableEntity
object
REQUIRED
]
